blocks.html: Harness the Power of Red Light For Your Body

Discover the powerful synergy of red light therapy combined with our signature massage at Elements Wellness. Red light was originally developed by NASA for its therapeutic effects, such as accelerating healing, reducing pain and inflammation, and boosting overall well-being. When paired with our massage, the effects are amplified—offering deeper relaxation, improved muscle recovery, and a more holistic approach to pain relief and fatigue management.
What is Red Light Therapy (RLT)?

Red light therapy (RLT), also known as photobiomodulation, is a treatment that uses low-level red and near-infrared light to help cells work better, promoting healing, improving skin, reducing pain, and aiding muscle recovery. See more detailed benefits below.

blocks.text: Red Light vs Infra-Red Light, what is the difference?
blocks.html: Red Light vs Infra-Red Light, what is the difference?
The main difference between red light and infrared light is their wavelength and visibility:

Red Light (Visible Light, ~620-700nm)

  • Can be seen by the human eye.
  • Penetrates the skin’s surface, mainly benefiting the skin by boosting collagen, reducing inflammation, and improving overall tone.

Infrared Light (Invisible Light, ~700-1,000nm+)

  • Not visible to the human eye.
  • Penetrates deeper into the body, reaching muscles and joints to promote healing, reduce pain, and improve circulation.

At Elements Wellness, we use dual wavelengths (650nm and 940nm) to penetrate deep into the skin, muscles and joints, promoting natural healing within cells, faster recovery, pain relief, and skin rejuvenation—all while enjoying your favourite spa treatment.

Frequently Ask Question

What is Red Light Therapy?

Red Light Therapy is a non-invasive treatment that uses specific wavelengths of light (650nm and 940nm) to penetrate the skin and tissues, stimulating cellular repair, reducing inflammation, and promoting overall wellness.

How does this work during my massage?

During your massage session, a specialized Red Light Therapy LED mat is applied to targeted areas, allowing the wavelengths to deeply penetrate tissues and promote healing. This treatment is completely pain-free, safe, and relaxing, making it an effortless way to amplify the benefits of your massage.

How does Red Light Therapy enhance my massage?

When combined with massage, Red Light Therapy works simultaneously to improve circulation, reduce muscle soreness, speed up recovery, and promote deep tissue healing.

Is Red Light Therapy safe?

Yes! Red Light Therapy is 100% safe, painless, and free from harmful UV rays. It has been extensively researched and is used by medical professionals, athletes, and wellness centers worldwide.

What are the benefits of Red Light Therapy?

Red Light Therapy can help with:

  • Pain relief and reduced inflammation
  • Faster muscle recovery
  • Skin rejuvenation and collagen production
  • Improved circulation
  • Better sleep quality
  • Mood enhancement and reduced stress
How long does a Red Light Therapy session take?

The therapy is applied during your massage session and typically lasts 20 minutes, depending on the area being treated.

Will I feel anything during the treatment?

Red Light Therapy is a gentle and soothing treatment. Most clients feel a slight warmth, similar to mild sunlight, but no discomfort or irritation.

How many sessions do I need to see results?

Many people experience benefits after just one session, but for optimal results, a series of treatments is recommended, especially for chronic pain or skin concerns.

Can I do Red Light Therapy if I have sensitive skin?

Yes! Red Light Therapy is gentle and suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. It does not cause burns, irritation, or downtime.

When is the best time to do Red Light Therapy for workout recovery?

The best time to use Red Light Therapy for workout recovery is both before and after exercise, as each session offers unique benefits.

Before a Workout – Applying Red Light Therapy right before exercising helps increase circulation, enhance endurance, and improve muscle performance. It also reduces the risk of injury and sets the stage for a smoother recovery.

After a Workout – Red Light penetrates the skin to activate tissue repair, it shortens the recovery time and hence reduces inflammation that makes muscles feel sore. Additionally, it supports muscle growth and improved tone, helping you achieve better fitness results.
